prompt: Create an original 150 second instrumental neo-soul instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: electric piano, electric bass, clean guitar, drums. Style: pocket groove with syncopated seventh chords. Tempo approximately 84 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A smooth, groovy instrumental track with a chill and positive vibe. Features a prominent electric bassline, clean electric guitar melodies, synth pads, and a steady drum beat, complemented by piano.
description.zh: 一首流畅、律动感十足的纯音乐，氛围轻松积极。以突出的电贝斯线、干净的电吉他旋律、合成器铺底和稳定的鼓点为特色，并辅以钢琴演奏。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
